_readme: Choices for scripts/migrateTagsToTaxonomy.js. Edit, then re-run --dry-run.
tagRenames: an item tag string -> the existing tag it should become (typos, case variants).
eventGroups: an item's ceremony/film value -> 'ceremony:<label>' or 'film-type:<label>', or null to put it in the hidden Unsorted group.
Combined values such as 'Haldi & Mehendi' are yours to decide: one ceremony, or leave in Unsorted.
filmTypes: the Film type group (films only, one per film).
